column4: cleat#3547: these tests build their shards from real PostgreSQL databases (newRealShards -> bootstrapScratchDB), and sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration -- no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists (same reason as a-concurrent-deploys-of-one-version-leave-the-shards-agreeing.tsv). They skip as bare test names. Four skips: the four top-level tests in a_deprecate_and_purge_take_the_cross_shard_lock_test.go (the timeout test's deprecate/purge subtests never start, so they add none). multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so they skip here.

cleat#3547: same four tests, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. They run, and pass, under test-go/engine and cluster, which set the PostgreSQL DSN.
